title: Purtenance
summary: PUR'TENANCE, noun [from the Latin pertinens, pertineo. See Appurtenance. (that which belongs to something else; an adjunct; an appendage)] Appurtenance; but applied to the pluck of an animal, Exodus 1

inlines.v: PUR'TENANCE, noun [from the Latin pertinens, pertineo. See Appurtenance. (that which belongs to something else; an adjunct; an appendage)] Appurtenance; but applied to the pluck of an animal, Exodus 12:9.
